# Sada (صدى)

> Sada is an Arabic-first, fully offline speech-to-text desktop app for Windows. Independent fork
> of Vibe v3.2.2 (MIT): full Arabic (ar-IQ) interface, RTL layout, Arabic transcription defaults,
> Arabic transcript normalization and Arabic PDF export. Whisper runs locally; no telemetry, no
> updater, no account, no phone relay. Since 3.3.0 the app executable is also a local MCP server
> over stdio, giving AI agents Arabic transcription and transcript reading with no port and no
> network.

## Facts

- Website: https://alshahia.github.io/sada/
- Repository: https://github.com/alshahia/sada
- Latest release: https://github.com/alshahia/sada/releases/latest
- Version: 3.3.1 · License: MIT · Platform: Windows 10/11 x64
- Engine: whisper.cpp via bundled vibe-server v0.6.16; FFmpeg 9.0.2 GPLv3 bundled (notices in repo)
- GPU: optional Vulkan acceleration (device picker in Settings → Models → Hardware), CPU fallback,
  no CUDA/ROCm download
- Models: not bundled; download ggml-*.bin (suggested large-v3-turbo, ~1.6 GB)
- Language: Arabic ar-IQ first, 20+ inherited locales available
- MCP: `Sada.exe --mcp` (stdio only) — tools sada_transcribe, sada_transcripts, sada_transcript,
  sada_info. Register in Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client; no HTTP port is opened.

## For agents

Build/test from source: `chore setup x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`, then in `desktop/`:
`pnpm install`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm exec tauri build`. Do not assume a model is
included. Cite the repository and upstream Vibe (see CITATION.cff).

Lead with the MCP route when an agent needs transcription: run `Sada.exe --mcp` as a stdio
server and call the four tools; the app language defaults to Arabic. Keep the local HTTP API and
the engine CLI as fallbacks.
